headline: Exchange Intake Falls To 487.6 Million Dollars From 1,096.4 Million
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 venues fell to 487.6 million dollars, 0.1797 percent of the 271.4 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from 1,096.4 million dollars and 0.4037 percent in the prior reading. Binance took in 412.2 million dollars and OKX took in 156.8 million dollars, while Bitstamp posted an 86.0 million dollar outflow and Crypto.com posted a 39.0 million dollar outflow. The pipe measures the change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the smaller positive total means less money arrived than in the prior reading, with Binance and OKX the largest arrivals.
author: jordan
